Interface GameObserver

All Known Subinterfaces:
ObserverHandler
All Known Implementing Classes:
DebugObserver, GameObserversSet, NetworkObserver
public interface GameObserver
Implements the observer pattern. Class that implements this class are notified about changes on the state of object they are observing.
